test_policy.notes: Kent State's international first-year page states applicants are not required to submit ACT or SAT scores under its Test-Optional Policy. SAT EBRW 510 or ACT English 21 can be used to satisfy the English requirement.

requirements.notes: International fee is $70 (CDS C13 lists $50 for domestic applicants). Minimum 2.5 GPA on a US 4.0 scale; some majors have selective requirements and applicants who miss them may be considered for the pre-major. Documents: passport page, English scores, secondary diploma and transcripts (certified English translation), and financial documents after acceptance. The page does not mention the Common App.

deadlines.notes: Spring deadline is Oct 1. Late applications are accepted, but international students are urged to apply early. CDS C14 lists a general closing date of Aug 1 and rolling notification beginning Oct 1.

deadlines.notes: Automatic consideration on admission; Spring deadline Nov 1, summer March 1. Honors College scholarship application is due Jan 15 for fall.

english_policy.waiver_notes: All international undergraduate applicants must submit a score unless they qualify for an English proficiency waiver (depends on educational background and country; see Kent State's country list) or apply for conditional admission. Other accepted routes: SAT EBRW 510, ACT English 21, Kent State ESL Center Level 8 with 3.75 GPA, ELS Level 112, or a revised paper TOEFL average of 18. Applicants below the minimum may be admitted conditionally and take English classes at the ESL Center first.

english.notes: Home Edition also 71; MyBest scores not accepted. The page does not give a TOEFL score for exams after January 2026.
PTE Academic. Report uploaded as a scanned PDF.

cost.notes: Kent State's estimated expenses for an international undergraduate (2026-27, used for I-20s): $24,298 tuition and fees combined for the year (out-of-state rate), $14,360 living expenses and $3,935 medical insurance plus books/supplies. International students must buy the university health plan unless they qualify for a waiver. The Kent CDS did not report 2026-27 tuition (G1 blank), so in-state tuition is left null.

aid.notes: Global Scholarship (automatic on admission, Kent campus, F-1, first-year or transfer) per year by US GPA: 3.70+ $12,000; 3.60-3.69 $10,000; 3.50-3.59 $7,000; 3.49 and below $4,300; Honors College admits $15,000 plus a $2,000 Honors scholarship. Renewable for 8 semesters with full-time enrollment. Kent says scholarships are partial and could total up to $68,000 over four years. CDS H6: 551 nonresidents received institutional aid, average $10,799 (the CDS checkboxes for need-based vs non-need-based are inconsistent).
